project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Instrumental Uplifting Hook-Heavy

arrangement.notes: An uplifting West Coast Hip-Hop instrumental arrangement with emphasis on hook-heavy energy. Modern sample chopping techniques used for sample layers. Channel names inspired by chopping techniques to reflect the sample treatment.

channels.SliceChop_1: sample slices triggered in rhythmic pattern
channels.RepeatTrigger_5: repeated triggering of key slice samples

sound_intent.overall_character: clean, punchy, modern West Coast vibe with chopped sample textures
sound_intent.sample_layering: use modern chopping effects to create rhythmic catchiness
sound_intent.energy_profile: hook sections maximize energy and presence

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation with sample chop inspired percussion
track_roles.bass: groove support using chopped and repeated samples
track_roles.melody: main motifs through reversed and chopped samples
track_roles.fx: effects lane with stutters and sample glitches

designer_intent.focus: Create an uplifting West Coast instrumental emphasizing modern sample chopping with hook energy
designer_intent.avoid: no lyrics, melodic lines must come from samples not played instruments

presetor_intent.effects: apply modern hip-hop presets tailored for crisp percussion and chopped samples
presetor_intent.mixing: balance hook energy with clarity and punch

sensei_drum.brief: Generate and arrange drums with a focus on sample chopping inspired rhythms and maintaining groove energy

bass_generator.brief: Create bass parts using repeated and pitch-modulated sample snippets that support the rhythm and hook energy

harmony_generator.brief: Provide harmonic layers via pitch-shifted chopped sample based chords to complement the bass and melody

melody_generator.brief: Craft melodic phrases by employing reversed and sliced samples to keep the hook sections dynamic and uplifting

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement ensuring energy peaks in the hook and instrumentals maintain uplifting mood with sample techniques

presetor.brief: Set appropriate effects and mix presets tailored for West Coast hip-hop with emphasis on sample clarity and punch

songgps.brief: Guide sectioning with clear intro, verses, hooks and final hook focusing on energy curves and hook prominence

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix raw channel audio to preserve dynamic range and highlight described arrangement energy profile
